snippet.title: Cows Gone Mad: Battle For Pasture Prime | Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Experience the beginning of an epic saga in "Cows Gone Mad"! A mysterious meteorite crashes into Pasture Prime, transforming ordinary cows and wolves into extraordinary beings. This marks the start of an intense war between the newly evolved species. Watch as a peaceful farm transforms into a fierce battleground. Don’t miss out on the action—subscribe for more thrilling updates and join the battle that will redefine their world!
